senses.definition: (intransitive) To form cracks.

senses.definition: (intransitive) To break apart under force, stress, or pressure.

senses.definition: (intransitive) To break down or yield, especially under interrogation or torture.

senses.definition: (intransitive) To make a cracking sound.

senses.definition: (intransitive, of a voice) To change rapidly in register.
examples: His voice cracked with emotion.

senses.definition: (intransitive, of a person's voice during puberty) To alternate between high and low register in the process of eventually lowering.
